description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_Injector_Linkify class, which detects URLs in text and converts them into clickable hyperlink elements within HTML. It handles transforming plain URLs like 'http://example.com' into HTML anchor tags.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_Linkify
classes.description: An injector class that scans text tokens for URLs and converts recognized URLs into HTML anchor ('a') elements.

methods.name: handleText
methods.description: Processes a text token, identifies URLs within the token data, and converts URLs into link elements by splitting the token accordingly.
